lookup_method: Every PMID in this file was retrieved live from PubMed via the repo's own client (panoscope.agent.mcp_client.PubMedMCP -> @cyanheads/pubmed-mcp-server 2.11.1 over stdio MCP): search_articles() for candidate PMIDs, then fetch_articles() for title/year/journal/abstract. No PMID, title, year or journal in this file was written from memory. Three batched passes with a 0.35-0.4 s inter-call delay: pass 1 'GENE <cell-type phrase> marker human breast' + 'GENE marker <cell-type phrase> single-cell human' + 'GENE <cell-type phrase>'; pass 2 'GENE immunohistochemistry <cell-type phrase> human tissue marker' + 'single-cell RNA sequencing human breast tumor GENE <cell-type phrase> marker' + 'GENE expression identifies <cell-type phrase>'; pass 3 (only for the 9 pairs that returned nothing) alias-first queries using the protein/CD name (e.g. 'smooth muscle myosin heavy chain', 'CD11c', 'oxytocin receptor'). Candidates were mechanically pre-filtered to abstracts containing both the gene symbol (or a protein/CD alias) and a cell-type keyword; every retained candidate was then read and graded by hand. Grading rubric: 'supported' = the fetched title or abstract explicitly states that the gene/protein marks, identifies or is specifically expressed by that cell type in human tissue; 'weak' = the gene-cell-type link is present but indirect (functional or therapeutic-target study, a subset rather than the type, a correlational deconvolution result, or non-human); 'none' = no retrieved abstract supports the pair. Breast context is NOT required for 'supported' (most immune-lineage markers have no breast-specific abstract) but every row's note says whether the citation is in human breast tissue. Notes also record contrary evidence where a retrieved abstract argues against the pair.

pairs.title: Significance, detection and markers of disseminated breast cancer cells.
pairs.query: ERBB2 breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells marker human breast
pairs.note: Only retrieved support lists ERBB2 among markers used to DETECT disseminated breast tumour cells; ERBB2 marks the HER2 subtype, not the epithelial lineage. No abstract calls it a canonical tumour-cell identity marker.

pairs.title: EpCAM-Independent Enrichment of Circulating Tumor Cells in Metastatic Breast Cancer.
pairs.query: EPCAM breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells marker human breast
pairs.note: Human breast cancer: abstract states CTC assays rely on 'the cell surface marker epithelial cell adhesion molecule (EpCAM)' to detect tumour cells. Context is circulating, not tissue, but the marker attribution is explicit.

pairs.title: Fibroblasts prepared from different types of malignant tumors stimulate expression of luminal marker keratin 8 in the EM-G3 breast cancer cell line.
pairs.query: KRT8 breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells marker human breast
pairs.note: Title names keratin 8 a 'luminal marker' in a breast cancer cell line. Cell-line context.

pairs.title: Loss of Cytokeratin 7 (CK7) Expression Can be Seen in Significant Proportion of Solid Papillary Carcinoma of Breast and Associated Invasive Component.
pairs.query: KRT7 breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells marker human breast
pairs.note: Abstract: 'Cytokeratin 7 (CK7) is a marker of epithelial differentiation and is positive in >90% of breast carcinomas... Pathologists use CK7 in the breast to confirm epithelial differentiation.' Human breast, diagnostic IHC.

pairs.title: FOXA1 Induces E-Cadherin Expression at the Protein Level via Suppression of Slug in Epithelial Breast Cancer Cells.
pairs.query: FOXA1 breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells marker human breast
pairs.note: Abstract: 'FOXA1 is a transcriptional regulator preferentially expressed in epithelial breast cancer cells, and its expression is lost in mesenchymal breast cancer cells.' Functional paper, but the attribution is explicit and breast-specific.

pairs.title: GATA3: a multispecific but potentially useful marker in surgical pathology: a systematic analysis of 2500 epithelial and nonepithelial tumors.
pairs.journal: The American journal of surgical pathology
pairs.query: GATA3 breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells marker human breast
pairs.note: Am J Surg Pathol systematic survey of 2500 tumours: 'GATA3 is a transcription factor important in the differentiation of breast epithelia'. Note the title's own caveat: 'multispecific' (urothelium, T-cell subsets).

pairs.title: Cytokeratin 5/6 in normal human breast: lack of evidence for a stem cell phenotype.
pairs.query: KRT8 breast carcinoma tumor epithelial cells
pairs.note: Normal human breast: abstract treats CK8/18 as the differentiated-luminal marker pair (cells expressing CK5/6 'without expression of CK8/18'). Retrieved under the KRT8 query; cross-used for KRT18.

No retrieved abstract supports LUM/lumican as a fibroblast or stromal-cell marker. Closest: PMID 15613083 (human gingiva SLRP localisation) distinguishes lumican from the proteoglycans that DID localise to fibroblasts. Literature is thin for this pair.

pairs.title: CAF-Associated Genes in Breast Cancer for Novel Therapeutic Strategies.
pairs.query: VIM cancer-associated fibroblasts stroma
pairs.note: Human BREAST: POSTN identified as a breast CAF-associated gene with the highest stromal expression and R=0.94 correlation with the CAF marker SPARC in BC cancer stroma.

pairs.title: Fibroblasts in urothelial bladder cancer define stroma phenotypes that are associated with clinical outcome.
pairs.query: PDGFRA cancer-associated fibroblasts stroma
pairs.note: PDGFR-alpha is one of five fibroblast markers assessed by IHC, but in urothelial bladder carcinoma, not breast. No breast-context abstract found.

pairs.title: Prognostic and predictive impact of stroma cells defined by PDGFRb expression in early breast cancer: results from the randomized SweBCG91RT trial.
pairs.query: PDGFRB expression identifies cancer-associated fibroblasts stroma
pairs.note: Human BREAST, IHC on 989 tumours: 'Cancer-associated fibroblasts ... can be identified by platelet-derived growth factor receptor-beta (PDGFRb).'

pairs.title: Characterisation of colorectal cancer by hierarchical clustering analyses for five stroma-related markers.
pairs.journal: The journal of pathology. Clinical research
pairs.query: DCN cancer-associated fibroblasts stroma
pairs.note: DCN named as one of five 'CAF-related or stromal markers' assessed by IHC. Colorectal cancer, not breast.

pairs.title: SPARC Induces COL1A1/COL3A1 Expressions Representing Aggressive Molecular Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts Signatures and CSF1-Mediated Cancer Invasion in Colorectal Cancer.
pairs.query: COL1A1 expression identifies cancer-associated fibroblasts stroma
pairs.note: Title places COL1A1 in an 'aggressive molecular cancer-associated fibroblast signature', but in colorectal cancer and as an induced expression programme rather than a cell-identity marker.

pairs.title: Pagetoid reticulosis. Histiocyte marker studies.
pairs.query: lysozyme histiocyte marker
pairs.note: Human tissue IHC using lysozyme as one of three cytoplasmic markers indicating 'monocyte-macrophage' lineage; 1984 dermatopathology, not breast. PMID 1376020 tested lysozyme for CNS macrophages and did NOT recommend it, favouring CD68/Ham-56/RCA-1.

pairs.title: The presence of tumor associated macrophages in tumor stroma as a prognostic marker for breast cancer patients.
pairs.query: CD68 macrophages tumor-associated myeloid marker human breast
pairs.note: Human BREAST: abstract calls CD68 'the more frequently used pan-macrophage marker' and evaluates TAMs in breast tumour stroma.

pairs.title: The presence of tumor associated macrophages in tumor stroma as a prognostic marker for breast cancer patients.
pairs.query: CD68 macrophages tumor-associated myeloid marker human breast
pairs.note: Same human BREAST paper: 'CD163 is regarded as a highly specific monocyte/macrophage marker for M2 macrophages.'

pairs.title: DOCK2 as a novel CD11c ligand in neutrophils to regulate reactive oxygen species production.
pairs.query: CD11c macrophage dendritic cell marker human
pairs.note: Abstract states CD11c (integrin alphaX) is 'traditionally recognized as a dendritic cell marker' and is expressed on only 'a subset of macrophage populations'. This is a flag against the dict's assignment of ITGAX to Macrophages.

pairs.title: \[Measurement of NK cell and macrophage activation\].
pairs.journal: Rinsho byori. The Japanese journal of clinical pathology
pairs.query: CD16 FCGR3A monocyte macrophage marker human
pairs.note: Abstract: FcgammaRIIIa (CD16) 'is expressed on NK cells, a subset of T lymphocytes, a subpopulation of monocytes and macrophages' - a subpopulation marker shared with NK/T cells, not a macrophage identity marker. Not breast.

No retrieved abstract states FCER1G marks macrophages. Nearest (PMID 28659358) only says Fcer1g acts in myeloid cells and is not expressed in B cells. Literature at abstract level is thin for this pair.

pairs.title: Evolution of myeloid-mediated immunotherapy resistance in prostate cancer.
pairs.query: CSF1R macrophages tumor-associated myeloid
pairs.note: CSF1R is targeted on tumour-associated myeloid cells (prostate), which implies but does not state macrophage-marker status. No breast-context marker statement found.
Nine distinct queries across three passes returned no article linking MYLK / myosin light chain kinase to breast myoepithelial cells. Literature is thin for this pair.

pairs.title: Expression of smooth muscle-specific proteins in myoepithelium and stromal myofibroblasts of normal and malignant human breast tissue.
pairs.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
pairs.query: smooth muscle myosin heavy chain breast myoepithelium diagnostic marker
pairs.note: PNAS, normal and malignant HUMAN BREAST: smooth muscle alpha-actin among smooth-muscle-specific proteins expressed in mammary myoepithelium. Same title flags expression in stromal myofibroblasts, so ACTA2 is not myoepithelium-specific.

pairs.title: Specific morphological features predictive for the basal phenotype in grade 3 invasive ductal carcinoma of breast.
pairs.query: KRT14 myoepithelial basal cells mammary marker human breast
pairs.note: Human breast: abstract opens 'Cytokeratin (CK) 14, a myoepithelial marker, is also expressed in a proportion of breast carcinomas.' The second clause is itself a specificity caveat.

pairs.title: Tissue microarrays for testing basal biomarkers in familial breast cancer cases.
pairs.journal: Sao Paulo medical journal = Revista paulista de medicina
pairs.query: TP63 immunohistochemistry myoepithelial basal cells mammary human tissue marker
pairs.note: 'The proteins p63, p-cadherin and CK5 are consistently expressed by the basal and myoepithelial cells of the breast.' Retrieved under the TP63 query; cross-used for KRT5.

pairs.title: Best practices in diagnostic immunohistochemistry: myoepithelial markers in breast pathology.
pairs.query: smooth muscle myosin heavy chain myoepithelial cells breast immunohistochemistry
pairs.note: Arch Pathol Lab Med best-practice review of breast myoepithelial IHC: smooth muscle myosin heavy chains listed among the markers best combining sensitivity and specificity. Review explicitly warns of cross-reactivity with myofibroblasts and vessels.

pairs.title: Oxytocin receptor signaling in myoepithelial and cancer cells.
pairs.journal: Journal of mammary gland biology and neoplasia
pairs.query: oxytocin receptor myoepithelial cells mammary gland
pairs.note: Review establishes oxytocin-receptor signalling in breast myoepithelial cells (contraction), but the same abstract reports OTRs on breast cancer cells, so OXTR is not myoepithelium-specific in tumour tissue. Direct myoepithelial OXTR binding data retrieved were rat (PMIDs 195965, 6303330).

pairs.title: p63, a p53 homologue, is a selective nuclear marker of myoepithelial cells of the human breast.
pairs.journal: The American journal of surgical pathology
pairs.query: TP63 myoepithelial basal cells mammary marker human breast
pairs.note: Am J Surg Pathol: 'p63, a p53 homologue, is a selective nuclear marker of myoepithelial cells of the human breast.' Best single citation in this file.

pairs.title: Tumor-Specific Effector CD8+ T Cells That Can Establish Immunological Memory in Humans after Adoptive Transfer Are Marked by Expression of IL7 Receptor and c-myc.
pairs.query: IL7R expression identifies T lymphocytes tumor infiltrating
pairs.note: IL7 receptor marks a persistent/memory-capable CD8 effector subset after adoptive transfer in humans - a T-cell SUBSET state, not a pan-T identity marker. Not breast.

pairs.title: CD45 expression in low-grade B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphomas.
pairs.query: PTPRC expression identifies T lymphocytes tumor infiltrating
pairs.note: Abstract states 'CD45 is a glycoprotein expressed in all lymphohemopoietic cells'. That is a pan-leukocyte marker, NOT T-cell-specific. Flag against the dict's assignment of PTPRC to T_Cells.

No abstract supports TRAC as a T-cell marker. Worse: PMID 15935573 reports 'Expression of the TCR genes is not restricted to T lymphocytes' and finds TCR alpha constant-region expression common in sarcomas - evidence against specificity. PMID 28225754 uses the TRAC locus for CAR knock-in, which is functional, not a marker claim.

pairs.title: A Novel Carcinoembryonic Antigen T-Cell Bispecific Antibody (CEA TCB) for the Treatment of Solid Tumors.
pairs.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
pairs.query: CD3E T lymphocytes tumor infiltrating
pairs.note: CD3e is used as the T-cell-engaging arm of a bispecific antibody, which implies CD3e is a T-cell surface antigen but never states it is a marker. No marker-attribution abstract found.

pairs.title: Comprehensive analysis reveals a prognostic and therapeutic biomarker CD3D in the breast carcinoma microenvironment.
pairs.query: CD3D T lymphocytes tumor infiltrating
pairs.note: Human BREAST carcinoma: CD3D 'had a strong correlation with T cells, particularly CD8+ T cells' by deconvolution. Correlational/bioinformatic, not a marker attribution.

pairs.query: CD4 immunohistochemistry T lymphocytes tumor infiltrating human tissue marker

pairs.title: The prognostic role of tumor-infiltrating CD4 and CD8 T lymphocytes in breast cancer.
pairs.query: CD4 immunohistochemistry T lymphocytes tumor infiltrating human tissue marker
pairs.note: Same human BREAST IHC paper: CD4 attributed to T-helper cells. Caveat not in this abstract: CD4 is also expressed by monocytes/macrophages.

pairs.note: CD79 review treats CD20 (MS4A1) as a B-cell-ontogeny landmark ('precedes ... CD20 expression ... disappears later than CD20 in the late (plasma cell) stage') but the paper is about CD79, not CD20. No dedicated CD20 marker abstract retrieved.

pairs.title: CD79: a review.
pairs.query: CD79A B lymphocytes plasma cells
pairs.note: 'CD79 is composed of CD79a and CD79b components expressed almost exclusively on B cells and B-cell neoplasms.' Review in a diagnostic-IHC journal. Not breast.

pairs.title: CD79: a review.
pairs.query: CD79A B lymphocytes plasma cells

pairs.title: MZB1 is a GRP94 cochaperone that enables proper immunoglobulin heavy chain biosynthesis upon ER stress.

pairs.note: HUMAN BREAST tissue and microvessel isolation: CD31, VE-cadherin and von Willebrand factor named as 'endothelial specific markers' used to localise breast microvasculature in situ.

pairs.query: CLDN5 immunohistochemistry endothelial cells tumor vasculature human tissue marker
